# StudioShot AI — Agentic Commerce & Capabilities Specification

> StudioShot AI is an automated AI-powered visual studio for e-commerce sellers. It converts phone-shot product images into marketplace-ready 3:4 portrait infographics, listing banners, and virtual model lookbooks.

## Core Services & Capabilities
- **Infographic Generator**: Transforms product photos into 3:4 portrait listing banners with customizable background studio aesthetics, brand logo overlays, 21 typography fonts, and callout badges.
- **AI Virtual Model Studio**: Converts flat-lay apparel photos into realistic human model lookbooks with customizable skin tones, torso fits (Male, Female, Kids), and studio backdrops.
- **Brand Integration**: Secure upload and automated overlay of custom brand logos using Gemini multimodal AI processing.

## Supported Marketplaces & Output Specs
- **Aspect Ratio**: Strict 3:4 Portrait Format (Optimized for Mobile Conversion).
- **Compatible Platforms**: Meesho, Amazon, Shopify, Flipkart, Instagram Shop.
- **Output Formats**: HD JPEG/PNG.

## Pricing & Tiers
- **Free Tier**: Trial generation with standard studio backgrounds.
- **Pro Tier**: Full HD exports, unlimited brand logo integrations, custom font styling, and priority AI processing.

## API & Integration Manifest
- Manifest Endpoint: /api/agent/manifest
- Infographic Generation Endpoint: /api/generate-infographic
- File Upload Endpoint: /api/upload-infographic
